scope: Independent whole-object Reason audit of all 162 current OOD-N03 items; no proposal/source implementation or answer review is implied.

requirement.rule: Reason is concise and identifies the decisive condition and decision; it must not paraphrase the correct option or consist of praise.

reviewMethod: Read all 162 current prompts, correct option texts, Reasons, and relevant Details; mechanically checked normalized exact equality for every Reason/correct-option pair, then manually reviewed non-exact Reasons for same-decision paraphrase or prompt echo without a distinct explanatory premise.
identityDisposition: All findings are feedback-only wording corrections. Preserve all 25 existing question IDs, option IDs, keyed answers, prompts, Details, and accepted meanings.
